Title: Paginated reports in Power BI is in preview

Body.Content:
Paginated reports functionality is now available in Power BI Premium, allowing you to view and interact with your pixel-perfect paginated reports right alongside your existing Power BI interactive reports in the Power BI portal.

See the Power BI blog for more information.
